summary: The course management /api/teaching/courses and /api/teaching/courses/[courseId]/classes routes reject signed student app-session cookies whose account is an unsafe server id before course list readback, teacher-role classification, or class writes can run.
behaviorHardened: Course list reads now treat unsafe signed student account ids as unauthenticated instead of returning a student course-list receipt.
Class creation now treats unsafe signed student account ids as unauthenticated instead of classifying the request as a valid student role denial.
Denied responses preserve trace ids, omit unsafe local-path-like account values, and do not write course, class, membership, or audit records.
Normal signed student account behavior remains covered by the existing course-list and invite-code membership tests.

red.observedFailure: Focused regressions failed before implementation: course list returned HTTP 200 with the unsafe student account in the receipt, and class creation returned HTTP 403 teacher-role-required instead of HTTP 401.

green.observedPass: Focused regressions passed after implementation with three tests passed and fifty skipped.

verification.details: 66 files passed, 1317 tests passed; existing jsdom navigation warnings remained non-fatal

productionBoundary.remainingGateRisk: This is local backend/API auth-boundary hardening only. It does not replace fresh same-run production course-management route smoke, ordinary teaching browser smoke, deployment, external-storage, or live provider proof.
